entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network towards the UE for modifying a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING
entities.description: State where the network has initiated a PDU session modification procedure and is waiting for a response from the UE.

entities.name: Waiting for UE response
entities.description: Condition where the network is waiting for a response from the UE after initiating the PDU session modification procedure.

relations.description: The PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state is associated with the ongoing PDU session modification procedure.
The PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state is characterized by the condition of waiting for a UE response.
